theorems.hypotheses: finite directed multigraph with positive rational branch weights; W_ij is total one-step mass from i to j
theorems.statement: For every k>=0, the total positive weight of all length-k walks from i to j is exactly (W^k)_ij.
theorems.boundary: This is the total-mass projection only; count, provenance and dominant-path data remain separately typed.

theorems.hypotheses: W is a finite non-negative rational square matrix
theorems.statement: The all-depth mass series sum_{k>=0} W^k is finite entrywise iff there exists h in Q_{>0}^n with Wh<h coordinatewise; equivalently I-W is invertible and x=(I-W)^(-1)1 is positive rational.
theorems.canonical_potential: On the stable side x=W*1 and Wx=x-1.
theorems.gauge_form: With H=diag(h), every row sum of H^(-1)WH is <1; for canonical x the row sum is 1-1/x_i.
theorems.cycle_invariant: State gauge telescopes along paths and preserves every closed-cycle product.

theorems.hypotheses: same stable finite rational scope as WBRC-T13
theorems.statement: The exact recurrent total-mass star is W*=(I-W)^(-1) in M_n(Q_{>=0}); no numerical infinite summation or floating spectrum is required.
theorems.interpretation: The i-th row sum of W* is the total positive mass of all finite walks starting at i and ending anywhere, including the empty walk.

theorems.hypotheses: W=A/D with A in M_n(N_0), D>0
theorems.statement: Exactly one holds: (stable) exists h in N_{>0}^n with Ah<Dh; or (divergent) exists nonzero y in N_0^n with y^T A >= D y^T.
theorems.proof_boundary: Completeness uses the finite-dimensional rational Gordan-Stiemke/Farkas linear alternative; stable and divergent witnesses are mutually exclusive by direct pairing.
theorems.consequence: Both recurrent phases admit finite exact integer certificates.

theorems.hypotheses: finite positive rational recurrent branch system; M is the largest-one-step-branch matrix and W the total one-step-mass matrix
theorems.statement: A total-mass stability potential for W makes every live dominant branch contractive in the same gauge; therefore all closed dominant cycles contract.
theorems.converse: False: W=[[3/5,3/5],[3/5,3/5]] has every individual path weight (3/5)^k ->0 while total mass grows as (6/5)^k.
theorems.interpretation: Branch multiplicity can destabilize total mass even when every individual path contracts.

negative_boundaries.statement: Finite non-negative rational transition-mass recurrence is covered by WBRC-T12..T16. No theorem is promoted here for infinite state spaces, signed/amplitude recurrence, complex weights, or arbitrary non-rational exact weights.

supersession_note: WBRC-N05-GENERAL-SCC-NOT-PROMOTED remains provenance for the pre-PR1112 boundary but is narrowed by this addendum: finite non-negative rational systems are now proved; only the broader recurrent scopes remain unpromoted.
